response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and software development skills with exposure to diverse technologies and domains, but his experience lacks direct alignment with the core requirements of the Principal Performance Architect role, particularly in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator optimization, and hardware-software co-design for cloud infrastructure.
strengths: Extensive experience in software development across multiple domains (web, mobile, embedded, and AI-agent infrastructure).
Proven ability to work with high-performance systems and low-latency applications (e.g., DLang at Sociomantic, real-time data processing).
Strong open-source contributions and technical leadership, including workshops and talks on advanced topics.
concerns: No explicit experience with SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator performance analysis, or hardware-software co-design for cloud infrastructure.
Background is primarily in full-stack and application development, with limited exposure to the specialized hardware and system architecture skills required.
Educational background (Bachelor's in CS) meets the minimum requirement but lacks advanced degrees (PhD/Master's) or equivalent experience in relevant fields.

key_factors.factor: no direct AI accelerator optimization experience
